production.note: US model years 2004-2011. First: Mazda's 2004 US brochure. Last: Mazda's 2011 US brochure, titled '2011 Mazda RX-8' (mazda-us-rx8-2011-brochure).

body.note: Four-seat sports car with rear-hinged 'Freestyle' rear doors and no centre pillars; recorded as Coupe (no four-door sedan body), as when the car was held.

aspiration.note: No turbocharger or supercharger is listed; the RENESIS is naturally aspirated.

drivetrain.note: 'Front mid-engine/rear-wheel drive with Power Plant Frame'

transmission.note: 2006 brochure: '6-speed manual' and '6-speed Sport AT automatic'. 2004 and 2005 brochures: 6-speed manual and '4-speed Sport AT' automatic (mazda-us-rx8-2004-brochure, mazda-us-rx8-2005-brochure).

powerHp.note: Manual car. Quote (2007 spec deck): 'Horsepower, SAE net 212 @ 7,500 232 @ 8,500' (automatic, manual); the 2006 brochure (mazda-us-rx8-2006-brochure) and 2011 brochure (mazda-us-rx8-2011-brochure) give the same 232 @ 8500 rpm. 232 hp covers 2006-2011, six of the eight model years. 2004-2005 manual: '238 @ 8500 rpm' (automatic 197 @ 7200) (mazda-us-rx8-2004-brochure).

weightLb.note: Manual car, 2007 model year. Quote (Mazda's 2007 US specification deck): 'Curb Weight, Federal Spec (lbs.) 3075 3045' (automatic, manual). The 2008 and 2009 decks give 3,053 and 3,064 lb for the manual (mazda-us-rx8-2008-spec-deck, mazda-us-rx8-2009-spec-deck); no 2006 deck could be opened. Mazda's US brochures print the same figures under the label 'Curb weight with popular options (lb)': 2006 manual 3045 (mazda-us-rx8-2006-brochure), 2004-2005 manual 3029, 2011 manual 3065. Since Mazda labels the same number as a popular-options weight, the record keeps specBasis.weightQualifier 'popular-options': a car without those options is somewhat lighter. Accepted by the owner on 3 October 2026.
